answer: EigenTrust scores each agent by the principal eigenvector of the peer trust matrix, anchored to a small pre-vetted seed set, the lantern every trust path ultimately traces back to. Global trust mass is conserved, so a gale of freshly minted identities only splits the thin trickle honest peers actually vouch into them: a thousand fakes share one agent's scraps and each settles near zero. The honest seed core sits like basalt bedrock, edges into it are scarce and slashable, so buying real weight costs far more than any sybil ring can earn back.
